# Chips in a chip field render unstyled: list.Chip items get no windowId

## Context

The chip field example draws its chips with no chip styling: no border or radius, and each close button is the browser's default grey button with the `fa-times-circle` glyph spilling over its edge. The frames on PR #21327 show it on `dev` (`0128668721`) and at that PR's head alike; that PR fixed only the inline label.

Measured on the dev server, `examples/form/field/chip` at `6cbcd09625`, 1440 × 900, `neo-theme-light`:

```
stylesheets matching /chip/  src/form/field/Chip.css, src/list/Chip.css   (no component/Chip.css)
.neo-chip                    border 0px none, border-radius 0px
.neo-chip-close-button       background rgb(239, 239, 239), border 2px outset
```

`examples/list/chip` on the same server loads `component/Chip.css` from `src`, `theme-dark`, `theme-light` and `theme-neo-light`; its chips have a 1px border, a 15px radius and a transparent close button.

## The Problem

`Neo.component.Chip`'s theme files load only once a chip gets a `windowId`: `component.Abstract#afterSetWindowId()` is what calls `insertThemeFiles()`. `list.Chip#createItemContent()` creates its chips with `appName`, `parentId`, `tabIndex`, `itemDefaults` and the record's config, but no `windowId` (unchanged since `722f78a5d4`, 2021). A chip gets a window only when `list.Component#afterSetWindowId()` hands the list's window to items that already exist.

That is why the two examples differ. The chip list's items exist before the list joins its window, so they receive it. The chip field's store loads by `url`, so its chips are created after the field and its `ValueList` already hold a window. They never get one, and nothing else in that window loads `component/Chip.css`.

Loading the styles exposes a second gap. Styled chips are 30px tall (`--chip-height`), and the field's input row grows to 36px around them, but an inline label's outline stays at `calc(var(--textfield-input-height) + var(--textfield-border-width) * 2)`, 27px. The chips then hang below the outline's bottom edge.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/list/Chip.mjs` `createItemContent()`: the `Neo.create()` call without `windowId`.
- The other three `list.Component` subclasses in `src` pass it: `src/list/Circle.mjs`, `src/list/Buffered.mjs` and `src/calendar/view/calendars/List.mjs` (`windowId: me.windowId`).
- `src/form/field/chip/ValueList.mjs` extends `list.Chip`, so the field inherits the fix.
- `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css`: `.label-inline .neo-label-wrapper` is `position: absolute` with that fixed height. Its `.neo-has-character-count.label-inline` rule already lays the field out as a grid whose outline takes `grid-area: input` at `height: 100%`, so the outline spans the input row and the error sits below.
- Design authority: `#17312`'s acceptance criterion "Both shipped themes style the field token-governed", and `resources/css/src/component/Chip.css` (`.neo-chip { border: var(--chip-border); border-radius: var(--chip-border-radius) }`, `.neo-chip-close-button { background: none; border: 0 }`).

## The Fix

- Pass `windowId: me.windowId` in `list.Chip#createItemContent()`, as its siblings do.
- In `resources/css/src/form/field/Chip.css`, lay out `.neo-chipfield.label-inline` as the character-count grid does: the outline and the input row share `grid-area: input`, the error takes `error`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A chip that `list.Chip` creates after the list has a window carries that window. A unit spec shows it, red on base and green at head.
- [ ] AC-2: `examples/form/field/chip` loads `component/Chip.css`. Its chips show the theme's border and radius and a transparent close button.
- [ ] AC-3: The PR body shows the chip field at rest before and after.
- [ ] AC-4: `examples/list/chip` looks the same before and after.
- [ ] AC-5: With an inline label, the chip field's outline spans its input row, also when that row wraps, and a validation error sits below the outline.

## Out of Scope

- `Neo.create()` inheriting `windowId` from `parentId` across the engine. The siblings pass it explicitly; an engine-wide default is its own decision.
- The chip field's inline label (`#21324`, PR `#21327`).
- Any change to the chip design.

## Avoided Traps

- Loading `component/Chip.css` from `form/field/Chip.css` or through `additionalThemeFiles`. That paints over the symptom and leaves `list.Chip` the only `list.Component` whose items have no window.
- Only `height: 100%` on the outline, as `TextArea.css` does. An error renders in flow, so the outline then wraps the error too (measured with an error under the field: outline 388–441 px, input row 388–424 px). `TextArea.css` subtracts `1.5em` under `:has(.neo-textfield-error)`, which holds only for a one-line error.
